exact_statement: For every K>0 and every hypothetical positive K-witness of least essential dimension n, one may initially select, without loss of positivity or dimension, a maximum of D_K=H-KI in its finite orbit under quadratic output phases; jointly allowing invertible affine input maps additionally makes the selected source affine-influence-minimal. Alternatively choose a finite-orbit maximum ratio R=H/I>K and substitute K=R below. For each original coordinate with complete children g,h, signed Fourier arrays a_T,b_T and every outside character v, define E_v=sum_T[eta((a_T+b_(T+v))/2)+eta((a_T-b_(T+v))/2)], eta(t)=-t^2 log2(t^2), C_v=Fourier(gh)(v), B_v=sum_(j:v_j=1)(1-2Inf_j(h)). A quadratic-phase-stationary source satisfies C_0>=0 and E_v-E_0<=(K/2)(B_v+C_0-abs(C_v)). Any probability-weighted average of these inequalities also holds. Actual one-cofactor character rematching preserves BOTH complete child entropies and affine-minimum influences, hence their complete optimized reserve, while its actual total influence change is(B_v+C_0-s*C_v)/2. Every mixed Fourier row remains. If h is bent on m even bits, then E_v=E_0,B_v=0 and C_0=max_v abs(Fourier(gh)(v))>=2^(-m/2), so Inf_i(f)<=(1-2^(-m/2))/2; equality at the lower correlation bound forces gh bent. This is initial finite extremal-source admission, not a descendant-only implication or renewal of a spent ancestor bank. Genuine least dimension licenses nonnegative smaller-child reserves; phase stationarity alone does not imply that eligibility or a universal paid pair. For a finite CUBIC-phase maximum, every ORIGINAL proper pair A, every one of its four full branches r, character v and sign s also obeys E_(r,v,s)-H(f)<=(K/4)[B_v+sum_(j in A)C_(j,0)-s sum_(j in A)C_(j,v)], where C_(j,v)=Fourier(g_(r+e_j)*g_r)(v), B_v=sum_(l in v)(1-2Inf_l(g_r)), and E_(r,v,s) is the entropy of ALL signed four-branch Walsh rows with branch r replaced by s chi_v g_r. The actual influence change is exactly the same bracket divided by4, and ALL FOUR complete optimized child banks remain unchanged. This pair entropy depends on s in general, so no sign-independent or absolute-correlation shortcut is licensed. Cubic initial normalization has the same finite, least-dimension and joint-affine admission proof; it does not reoptimize a spent history or change a booked comparison rate.
hypotheses: Uniform finite Boolean signs; normalized signed Walsh coefficients; entropy bits; K>0
Quadratic-phase stationarity for singleton constraints; CUBIC-phase stationarity for original-pair constraints; both available by finite INITIAL orbit optimization
Finite phase-orbit deficit maximization, or finite ratio-orbit maximization at its own positive ratio; not merely restriction-ratio criticality
Critical terminal eligibility additionally requires least essential dimension among positive fixed-K witnesses
Initial normalization only: every prior history/debit and comparison rate remain if an actual later change is made
Bent corollary: the full selected cofactor is bent on even outside dimension m
